[[File:Lashaa_Silk.png|thumb|right|Lashaa silk]]
{{Quote|How should I know why Jabba wants Lashaa silk? He doesn't even wear clothes!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race">''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]''</ref>}}
'''Lashaa silk''' was a luxury cloth used in fine clothing. Around the era of the [[Galactic War]], between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Lashaa was used in [[Synthweaver|synthweaving]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and others.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe||type=item|Lashaa Force Expert's Armor}}</ref> While imprisoned by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] wore a [[Huttese slave-girl costume|dancing costume]] that included a split skirt made of the [[Silk/Legends|silk]].<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
